for requesting to mark IPv4/IPv6 sockets with transport as ECN
capable
column4: when required by a congestion algorithm.

column1: It is currently used and needed in DataCenter TCP (DCTCP)
requires both peers to assert ECT on all IP packets sent - it
uses ECN feedback (i.e. CE
from switches inside the data center to derive feedback to the
end hosts.

column2: simply add a new flag to icsk_ca_ops. Note that DCTCP's

column1: algorithm/behaviour slightly diverges from RFC3168
